name: Dawning Wood Catacombs
summary: Beneath Raven Hill Cemetery in western Duskwood, undead fill the Dawning Wood Catacombs. Skeletal guards and ravenous ghouls haunt their stone tunnels.

sections.title: Beneath Raven Hill
sections.body:
Beneath the ruined Raven Hill Cemetery, the Dawning Wood Catacombs hold the dead of the surrounding woods. Before twilight cursed the forest, those dead rested in these stone corridors. Now the catacombs shelter some of the region’s deadliest undead, and lone travelers face danger in their depths.

Two underground wings divide the catacombs. Animated skeletons guard ancestral tombs in the western passages. To the east, tunnels descend into a foul warren overrun by ravenous, disease-bearing ghouls.

faq.q: Where are the Dawning Wood Catacombs located?
faq.answer: The Dawning Wood Catacombs lie beneath Raven Hill Cemetery on Duskwood’s far western edge. Their entrances descend among sprawling grave markers and ruined crypts.

aliases: what is in dawning wood catacombs
faq.answer: Duskwood’s most concentrated and ferocious undead lurk inside. Heavily armed skeletal warriors defend the western wing, while savage, plague-ridden ghouls infest the eastern tunnels.

faq.q: Why were the catacombs built in the first place?
faq.answer: The catacombs were excavated as a grand burial vault for local families and luminaries, when the region was still green. The curse that later engulfed the woods reanimated those buried within.

faq.q: Is it safe to explore the catacombs alone?
faq.answer: Exploring the catacombs alone is perilous. Tight packs of aggressive undead can overwhelm isolated travelers, and the close tunnels leave little room to retreat.

angles.text: For a paladin, these catacombs hold the kingdom’s fallen, and their desecrated tombs call for the Light’s holy wrath.
For a priest, restless spirits and decaying corpses lie beneath Raven Hill’s stone vaults, denied their final rest. The catacombs test the faith of those who enter.
